steps.name: Brokering a Jewel Trade (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Parmila] and [Jubil] at the "Oscuras Mercenary Camp", then find [Asma] in "Lumen".

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I have a small favor to ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I've been so busy lately that I haven't paid enough attention to the company. Some of them are decent enough, but...

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Hahahahaha! Arcane body slam!

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I'll need cat food to find the cat.

lines.speaker: 그론
lines.text: Uuugh... (Hungry.)

lines.speaker: 마리스
lines.text: Can't do anything without earning money. Ugh...

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Hehe. This time, I'll create the ultimate miracle medicine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Which part of that looks decent?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: That's because you're looking at them with prejudice. Anyway, could you hear Jubil out? Not those lot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is something wrong with Jubil?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I listened, but it wasn't something I could solve.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: So I'm glad you're here. You have more experience, more strength, and more contacts than me. You might help her...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's just listening, I can do that.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Thank you. Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That laugh sounds suspicious... Still, it can't be anything serious...)

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: I've been so busy I never thanked you. We might have become undead together otherwise...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. Don't worry about it.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Did you need something from me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Parmila suggested I listen to what you have to say.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Oh, that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you don't mind telling me...?

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Then I will. I think you might be able to help, adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll decide after hearing it.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Hehe, fair enough. Lately, people in unusual clothes have been roaming Mirgandia. I asked, and they're called 'Jewel Stars.'

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: They put mana into gems, smash them with a bang, and attack monsters... Quite fascinating.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: And that means money!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, right. You come from a merchant family.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Yes, gem merchants. Completely bankrupt now, unfortunately.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: I want to earn enough to leave mercenary life behind. All I save here is pocket change. I need something solid.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Then Jewel Stars appeared. Supplying gems in bulk to Lumen, where so many live, could be a huge business!

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: I, Jubil, daughter of a gem merchant, won't let this chance pass.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: I know suppliers who can obtain the gems they need. That's why I'd like a firm favor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you want to sell gems in Lumen, but don't know anyone. You'd like me to make an introduction.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Exactly. I love how quickly you understand. I thought you might know someone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I do. Shall I at least ask? I need to visit Lumen anyway... But don't expect too much.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: On my father Silan's name, I feel this will work out. And I know I can do it well.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: If it succeeds, I'll give you something really good. A share, perhaps...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Share some with me later.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Thank you. I'm counting on you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm... Should I ask Asma? Would she hear me out about gems...?)

steps.name: Brokering a Jewel Trade (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Devouring Fire Spirits] in the "Chaos Canyon" and obtain a <Spirit Fragment>. Then report to [Pulse] in "Underground City Tartaros".

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Hello, adventurer. Oh, you seem to have something to say...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm... Someone asked me a favor. Let me explain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Asma about Jubil's request.)

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: (Asma looks troubled.)

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: I'm afraid this isn't my area. I can't give you a definite answer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, all right. Nothing to be done.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Still, we do need many gems. There's demand from mages who use them and from Jewel Stars...

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: And the barriers we must keep erecting are growing larger... Ah, perhaps he could give a firmer answer than I can.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: A stubborn man who thinks of nothing but research.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: (Asma's face suddenly hardens into an expression you've never seen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Pulse in Tartaros?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Yes. He knows the school's officers as well. Why not ask him?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll go there.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Before you leave, the school's officers wanted something brought to him. Could you fetch it and take it along? ♬

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel like I'll get a serious scolding if I refuse...)

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: I'll take that as a yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh. All right. I'll handle it on the way.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Find a 'Spirit Fragment' in the realm where spirits live and bring it to him.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Thank you. I hope things turn out well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Scary... I'd better avoid bringing up Pulse next time.)

steps.name: Brokering a Jewel Trade (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Evil Order] in the "Frozen World" and obtain a <Darkness-Infused Pearl>. Then report to [Pulse] in "Underground City Tartaros".

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Someone's standing right here. Does he really not notice?

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Oh, you're here?

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've brought something you need. And something to discuss.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Thank you for the item. But I'm not interested in anything else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Asma said I absolutely had to discuss it with you.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: No helping it, then. If Asma said so, I'll listen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain what brought you here from the Oscuras Mercenary Outpost.)

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: I understand. But I can't answer immediately.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: I have research waiting, and I'd need to contact my seniors about that... As it happens, I'm short of materials.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you need? I'll fetch it.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: A <Pearl of Darkness>. Not an easy item to obtain...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I suspect I won't finish this without helping somehow. I'll be right back.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Then I'll contact my seniors.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pulse! Pulse! I brought it.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Oh, you're back. Well done.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Regarding your request, my senior is sending someone with an answer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll wait.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: They're here, as it happens.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: (Someone dressed similarly to Pulse approaches and begins speaking. As he listens, Pulse's expression gradually hardens.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Did it not work out...?)

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Our school recently received a large shipment of gems. I don't know who the supplier is, but the quality seems quite good.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: And since there's no urgency, they don't intend to trade with anyone else for now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It can't be helped.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: My regrets. Now, if you'll excuse me...

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: Hello, Pulse. Oh, adventurer?

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: I came to ask Pulse a favor, but things look rather serious. Is something wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, nothing much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly explain the situation to Violet.)

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: Adventurer, could you come over to my place and tell me more? Oh, Pulse, I'll ask you another time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. Thank you, Pulse. See you again.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: That's good. Violet may have a useful answer. Oh...

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Already gone. I still had something to say...

steps.name: Brokering a Jewel Trade (5)
steps.objective: Talk to [Jubil] at the "Oscuras Mercenary Camp".

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: Ahem. I think I can help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don't have to force a decision...

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: No, this could help the Kingdom of Jude, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jude needs gems in bulk? There seemed to be so many in the Sun Palace...

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: As you know, our kingdom suffered greatly in the recent attack.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: Seeing a country they had trusted for so long in that state, the people lost faith in the state and the royal family.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: His Majesty considered this and ordered barriers installed at key locations, as in Lumen.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: Our mages began imbuing gems with mana to protect the capital first... We hadn't realized just how many gems it would require.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: We've been searching for gem suppliers. We couldn't find a suitable one in Eastland, and now you've brought this good news.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: Please tell her that Jude would like to trade with her.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: After that, I'll... Rather, we'll proceed through my father.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: I'm sorry for the trouble.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not at all. I'm glad I could help. I'll be going.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: That expression says you've brought good news.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Here's what happened...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Jubil that the Kingdom of Jude is interested.)

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Thank you. All I really needed was to sell the gems. You and I take a commission when the deal is arranged, and that's that.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Hehe. Now I need to build a solid business.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I hope it goes well.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Thank you. I'll tell you when there's more progress.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But where will you get enough gems to supply a kingdom? I kept wondering that while traveling.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Hmm... It's difficult to disclose, but since you helped, I'll tell you. Please don't repeat it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I won't.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Then I'll trust you. Have you heard of Xerenis Magic Academy?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I've heard the name.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Its chairwoman, Chloris, suddenly found the school with an excess of gems. She tracked me down and asked me to handle them.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: I'm curious how there came to be so many, but I didn't ask. It isn't my concern. I just need to sell them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: The academy gains funds, Jude gets its gems, and you and I earn a commission.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: A good deal, isn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It is. Still, could I visit the academy and hear about it myself?

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Xerenis forbids unauthorized visitors. Even knowing Chloris for so long, I can't arrange that.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Besides, the route there is blocked. Chloris sometimes comes through the Void Sea, but I never know when. I have to wait for her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand. It can't be helped.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: I'll tell Chloris how much you helped. They say half-elves repay kindness twice over, so look forward to it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A half-elf...)

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: That's enough about Chloris. We shouldn't talk about others too long.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Anyway, thank you. I'll count on you again next time!
